patch_description: This combines demand-weighted direct-link rewards with relay credit allocated across eligible two-hop routes, rather than giving every relay the full reward for an OD pair. It also adds a sparse, endpoint-local concentration penalty: pairs of links serving the same source or destination are discouraged when both correspond to a large share of that node’s demand. The relay interactions reward useful paths, while the endpoint couplings encourage spreading heavily concentrated traffic; both interaction families stay within the quadratic-term limit.
